source.snippet: Thread 'Opus 5.5 is definitely nerfed' — 'Last week I had it grinding for hours with the same prompts. Now it barely goes 30 minutes before it gets stuck on something it should have figured out on its own.' Points: 5, Comments: 5.

problem_statement: Professional developers and AI power users experience unpredictable performance degradation in LLM API services over time, breaking agentic workflows they depend on and costing hours of re-prompting and debugging.
target_segment: Developers and solo operators running agentic or long-horizon LLM workflows in production, paying for API access.
notes: 5 points, 5 comments, active Nov 2026 thread. Users are paying API customers noting concrete productivity loss ('hours' of work lost). Opportunity: a monitoring or alerting service that benchmarks model performance over time and notifies subscribers of regressions — clear SaaS billing model targeting paying API users.
